project_type: Next.js 15 App Router web app (TypeScript), deployed on Vercel with Neon Postgres serverless
test_framework: Vitest with vi.mock for dependencies; tests in web/tests/
verification_instructions:
1. cd web && npx tsc --noEmit
2. cd web && npm run lint
3. cd web && npm run test -- --run
4. cd web && npm run build
setup_instructions: cd web && npm install (already installed in workspace)
environment_constraints: next build must pass with NO env vars. All user-facing text in Spanish. Do NOT push or create PRs - commit directly to main and push to origin/main.
contribution_requirements: All 175 tests must stay green. tsc --noEmit must pass. npm run lint must pass. npm run build must pass (no env vars).
key_patterns: Lazy imports for DB/auth in server actions. REVIEW_STATUS in web/lib/riasec/types.ts drives status display. AdminClient gets initialSessions (SessionSummary[]) - pure client-side aggregation for reports is preferred. authorizeSessionRead in web/lib/auth/read-access.ts controls results page access. persistSession in web/lib/sessions.ts saves review_status as 'PENDING' currently. Sessions with cohortCode are group sessions (anonymous). Sessions without cohortCode are individual (require auth).
directory_structure: web/ contains the Next.js app. web/app/ has routes (assessment, results, admin, api/sessions). web/lib/ has sessions.ts, auth/, riasec/types.ts, email/, methods/, actions/. web/components/ has AssessmentClient.tsx and AdminClient.tsx. web/tests/ has Vitest test files.
